name: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited
blurb: Geely Automobile Holdings Limited is one of China's largest privately-owned automobile manufacturers, producing and selling passenger vehicles under the Geely, Lynk & Co, and Galaxy brands, among others. The company is the listed vehicle-manufacturing arm of Zhejiang Geely Holding Group, which also controls stakes in Volvo Cars, Polestar, Lotus, and the Smart brand (via a joint venture with Mercedes-Benz). Geely has aggressively expanded into new-energy vehicles (NEVs), competing in both the domestic Chinese market and select international markets. Its scale and brand portfolio make it a bellwether for China's auto industry transition toward electrification.
recent: On May 13, 2026, Daiwa lowered its target price on Geely Auto (00175) to HKD 23.7, contributing to a sharp single-day decline of approximately 5.2% to HK$21.38. The stock has remained under pressure, trading around HK$21.26 as of May 14, 2026. A block trade of roughly 2.35 million shares (HK$52.78 million) was recorded on April 27, 2026, signaling continued institutional activity in the name.
